title: TicketCast
tagline: TicketCast in an NFT ticketing frame for browsing and minting tickets right from the frame.
description:
TicketCast is an innovative blockchain-based event ticketing frame designed to simplify and secure the process of creating events and purchasing tickets.
Currently we can browse and go to mint the ticket for specific events from the frame.
In the future roadmap we would love to build and implement so that we can create and mint tickets from the frame itself.

TicketCast:
TicketCast is an innovative blockchain-based event ticketing frame designed to simplify and secure the process of creating events and purchasing tickets.

Features of this Frame: 
- Browsing Events
- Minting Event tickets


Work In Progress:

- and minting the tickets right into the frame
